context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the delivery-lead instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Agent: "Confirmed. Proceeding to Phase 2: Plan."

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run **analysis/requirements-clarifier** to clarify vague feature descriptions into actionable specifications.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Draft the PRD using **prd/create-prd**.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Review for completeness and feasibility with **prd/review-prd**.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **HARD GATE — PRD Approval:** Apply gate row 1. PRD must be explicitly approved before proceeding; if revised, loop back to create-prd before generating any tasks.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Review the full plan before proceeding.

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Define sprint goal, allocate capacity, flag deferred items.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **HARD GATE — Sprint Commitment:** Apply gate row 2. Do not proceed if capacity exceeds 80% or sprint goal is undefined.

checklist.name: instruction-9
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **HARD GATE — Retrospective Complete:** Apply gate row 3. Every "what didn't" must have an action item with owner and timeline; do not close the cycle without documented learnings.

checklist.name: instruction-10
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Review: [N] suggestions, [N] critical (resolved)
